demo_decisions.1-salicylic-acid-body-wash-350ml: Use 375 mL as the demo variant because the current page heading and selector say 375 mL; do not use the 350 mL URL slug as a size claim. Do not state all-skin suitability because the page conflicts on very dry skin.
demo_decisions.4-aha-bha-underarm-rollon-frag-free-75: Use the product heading as the variant name, but do not claim fragrance-free suitability: the ingredient block lists perfume. Treat that conflict as unresolved until the label or brand confirms it.
demo_decisions.advanced-hair-growth-serum: For demo navigation use the 50 mL dropper selected by the product page; do not assume the conflicting spray instruction or pick 1% versus 3% rosemary without the label.
demo_decisions.advanced-hair-growth-serum-30ml: For demo navigation use the 30 mL dropper shown in the selector; do not infer the conflicting spray steps or rosemary percentage.
demo_decisions.anti-frizz-serum: Prefer the current text how-to of 2–3 pumps as a tentative demo reference; the gallery says 1–2, so do not serve an unqualified dosage and direct the user to the product label.
demo_decisions.magnesium-glycinate-gummies-60n: The page says its updated recommendation is two gummies while existing packaging says one; prefer the updated page as a tentative demo reference, but disclose the mismatch and do not resolve dosage without the label or professional advice.
demo_decisions.multivitamin-gummies: Prefer the how-to and nutrition label showing one gummy as a tentative reference; because an FAQ says two, do not give an unqualified dose or select one disputed ingredient list.
demo_decisions.30-urea-foot-roll-on: Treat the silicone-free exclusion as unconfirmed because the ingredient list names silicones; do not present the product as silicone-free.
demo_decisions.1-peptide-ceramide-moisturizer: Do not select a copper tripeptide concentration: 1% and 2000 ppm are materially inconsistent and may describe different scopes.
demo_decisions.folli-advanced-plus-hair-growth-serum: Do not select an AnaGain percentage: the text and image give different values, and the source does not establish their equivalence.
demo_decisions.daily-hydration-kit: Keep the named 10% lotion and body wash as the kit identity and do not assign the mismatched 20% product ingredient block to either component.
demo_decisions.face-body-sunscreen-kit: Keep the kit products separate; do not choose a disputed size or assert both are fragrance-free from the conflicting page blocks.
demo_decisions.hydrocolloid-acne-pimple-patch: Prefer the detailed how-to as a tentative reference, but report that the FAQ gives a conflicting duration and do not recommend a single wear-time as confirmed.
demo_decisions.calcium-gummies: Do not assume elemental calcium equals the mass of calcium salt or convert the ambiguous nutrition table into a dose.
demo_decisions.dandruff-and-hairfall-kit: Do not claim sulfate-free because the kit shampoo ingredient list names a sulfate.
demo_decisions.sun-care-duo-head-to-toe: Do not claim the whole kit is fragrance-free while the component information conflicts.
demo_decisions.summer-essentials-kit: Do not apply an unscoped fragrance-free statement to all three components.
